headline: Suzy turns vampire in Disney+ series 'Hyeonhok', out Jan 6
sub: First character poster drops: 'Never be bewitched'
source: Source: Disney+ Korea, via Korean media
caption:
Suzy becomes a vampire in Disney+ original series 'Hyeonhok' (현혹), premiering Jan 6, 2027.

Based on the hit webtoon of the same name, the vampire mystery is set in 1935 Gyeongseong. Kim Seon Ho plays painter Yoon I-ho, who is hired to paint Song Jeong-hwa (Suzy), a woman hidden from the world for over half a century. Disney+ revealed her character poster and motion poster today with the tagline "Never be bewitched."
